info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Education Enrollments Materials-v1-spec
info.description: This API endpoint provides access to a comprehensive list of materials associated with education enrollments. It enables educational institutions and administrators to quickly retrieve relevant resources for enrolled students, enhancing their learning experience. Typically utilized by academic institutions, educators, and administrative personnel, this API facilitates the seamless integration of educational content management systems. Users can leverage this API to ensure students have immediate access to essential resources throughout their enrollment period.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all materials linked to the enrollment records. It provides a comprehensive list that can aid in managing and reviewing the resources assigned to each enrollment.

requestBody.description: The request body for this operation specifies the details necessary to retrieve enrollment materials. Ensure that the body contains all required fields as defined in the schema.

200.description: Successful retrieval of materials for enrollments.
